title: חנינא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Chanina: Abba bar Chanina; R. Zeira bar Chanina; R. Yehudah bar Chanina; R. Yochanan bar Chanina; R. Yosi bar Chanina; R. Yosef bar Chanina; R. Shmuel bar Chanina; R. Tanchum bar Chanina. [Glosses: Chanina. (a) Moed Katan 25a: Rabbi Ila and Rabbi Chanina—Yuchasin's reading is bar Pappi—did not go out [the retrieved Bavli also gives a version in which Ila went out]. The new Talmud editions did not correct it. (b) Sanhedrin 111a, near the end: R. Chanina ben Gamla; Ein Yaakov has Gamliel. It was not corrected. (c) Yevamot 58b: Rav Chanina sent in R. Yochanan's name. It should read Rabbi; it was not corrected. (d) Zevachim 83b and Menachot 26b, near the end: R. Chanina bar Minyomi taught “in R. Eliezer ben Yaakov.” I think it should read “in the school of R. Eliezer ben Yaakov.” Yoma 45b has “in the school” in that matter [the retrieved Menachot does too], and I was pleased; it was not corrected. (e) Eruvin 65b, near the end: R. Chanina bar Yosef; Yuchasin writes “son of Rabbah.” We find that he asked R. Yochanan. Perhaps it should read R. Chiyya bar Yosef.]
